subject: Align four Plots in one graph with same length of y-and x-axis

messages.author: 7b686cee16ef4d9d
messages.subject: Align four Plots in one graph with same length of y-and x-axis
parts:
Dear Community,
I create four figures with the ggplot function in order to plot all figures on one page.
Now, I have two problems:

1.) I would like that all single plots have the same margin or same length for y- and x-axis (but the y-axis in each plot have different dimensions)

2.) and I would like to align the plots, the lower figure to the bottom and the upper figure to the top and to the left and right.

Here my code for only one of the figures (they look all the same, only the variable change)
di <-ggplot(regmesdse28, aes(treat, dissmean, shape=factor(disp)))+geom_point(size=5,position=pd)+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=dissmeandissse,ymax=dissmean+dissse),colour="black",width=.1,position=pd,size=.7)+ylab("Dissimilarity")
+ylim(0.1,0.4)+theme_bw()+theme(aspect.ratio=1.5)+theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=16, face="bold", colour="black",vjust=0.2),axis.text.y=element_text(size=12,face="bold",colour="black"))
+theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),axis.text.x=element_text(size=12,face="bold",colour="black"))+scale_shape_discrete(name="Dispersal rate")
+theme(legend.position=c(0.8,0.87))
+theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
+theme(legend.key=element_blank())
+theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black",size=1.5))
+theme(axis.ticks=element_line(colour="black",size=1),axis.ticks.length=unit(0.3,"cm"))
bi<-ggplot(...........
ri<-ggplot(.........
ev<-ggplot(.........

Then I used the grid and viewport() function to arrange all four plots on a single page:

grid.newpage()

pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2, 2, widths=unit(1,"npc"),heights=unit(1,"npc"),just="center", respect=TRUE)))
vplayout <- function(x, y)
viewport(layout.pos.row = x, layout.pos.col = y)
print(ri, vp = vplayout(1, 1))
print(di, vp = vplayout(1, 2))
print(bi, vp = vplayout(2, 1))
print(ev,vp=vplayout(2,2))

The output is attached.

Have you any suggestion or comments.

Thanks in advance for your help,
Nils

messages.subject: Re: Align four Plots in one graph with same length of y-and x-axis
parts:
Here is a quick example:

library(grid)
library(plyr)
library(gtable)

ps <- dlply(mtcars, .(vs, am), function(d)
ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(ggplot(d, aes(cyl, mpg)) + geom_point())))
r <- rbind(cbind(ps[[1]], ps[[2]], size = "first"), cbind(ps[[3]],
ps[[4]], size = "first"), size = "first")
grid.draw(r)


Winston and Hadley, cbind.gtable and rbind.gtable cannot work with
size = min/max in some cases.

kohske
